title: Venice
intro: The route leaves Slovenia and crosses into Italy for a compact visit to Venice. After parking at Piazzale Roma, the afternoon is spent walking through the historic center to the Grand Canal, Rialto Bridge and St. Mark's Square before returning to the car and continuing west to Brescia.

stops.name: Kamnik
stops.description: Leave Kamnik and begin the drive west toward Italy.

stops.name: Piazzale Roma
stops.description: Park at Venice's road-access point and continue through the historic center on foot.

stops.name: Rialto Bridge & Grand Canal
stops.description: Walk to Rialto Bridge for one of the classic views over Venice's Grand Canal.

stops.name: St. Mark's Square
stops.description: Continue to Piazza San Marco for the heart of historic Venice.

stops.name: Piazzale Roma
stops.description: Walk back to Piazzale Roma and continue the road trip.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Finish the day in Brescia, which becomes the base for the next part of the trip.
